text: {"assertions":["A flaky CI pipeline job in build/ci/pipeline.yml was reproduced by rerunning the same commit ten times.","The flaky job only appeared when two requests raced on the same key.","The root cause was a serialiser dropping unknown fields during processing.","The fix switched to a strict schema that rejects unknown fields, implemented in PR #2925 on branch fix/flaky-job-1.","The fix reduced flaky test failures from 82 per 100 runs to zero.","The CI pipeline stack uses YAML with pipeline replay as the covering check."]}
